flags.text: metadata/status marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
flags.evidence: Prior rationale treated six below-target results as automatically false success; this is withdrawn because bounded residual and stable-force plateau can qualify. Independently, M2 laminar metadata SHA256 2be9f6ef26942dd399a3f309091b1b56d1dbb8036c2e1e521180a91271970576 marks converged at 1386 despite force CSV SHA256 d4491fb52f42154ae0424d2dc4c46c7a98bbfe09c2f39d8653f651eabb60618a decreasing Cd0.339895→0.167402 in final200 and 0.198447→0.167402 in final50. Report e55282a:solver/report/results.tex:281 repeats convergence and 0.1674; real 3-order residual drop alone does not justify clear early laminar convergence under TASK.md:140,172. Other cases require separate review.

limitations: No evaluator build or MPI rerun.
Structural validation does not prove convergence.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
